notes: SCOPE/YEAR: Current two-term system (the return from three terms to two terms took effect in 1447 AH / 2025-26). The books found online are labelled ف1 1448 for term-1 books and ف2 1447 for term-2 books (the term-2 books for 1448 are not out yet). With the move to two terms, the old three-term books were MERGED. Examples: أحياء 2-1 now = old 2-1 plus تركيب الخلية والطاقة الخلوية (9 chapters). أحياء 2-2 = human body plus التكاثر الخلوي and the genetics chapters (10 chapters). كيمياء 2-1 = 7 chapters including حالات المادة and الغازات. كيمياء 2-2 = 6 chapters, from الطاقة to المركبات العضوية الحيوية. فيزياء 3-1 and فيزياء 3-2 = 9 chapters each, ending with الفيزياء النووية. علم البيئة 1-1 and 2-1 are now one book of 5 chapters. Many teacher sites (e.g. madty.net «توزيع» pages, the salisedu كيمياء 2-1 page) still show the OLD three-term contents. Where sources disagreed, the merged version was used, checked against at least two sites (kottby.net, salisedu.com, mnhaji.com, beadaya.com). WHICH BOOKS, BY TRACK (from madty.net track pages). Grade 10, the common first year: كيمياء 1 and أحياء 1 in term 1; فيزياء 1 and علم البيئة in term 2. Grade 11, general track: كيمياء 2-1, أحياء 2-1 and فيزياء 2 in term 1; كيمياء 2-2 and أحياء 2-2 in term 2. The health and life track takes فيزياء 2 in term 2 instead. The computer science and engineering track has the same chemistry and biology books. Grade 12, general, health and computer science tracks: فيزياء 3-1, كيمياء 3 and علوم الأرض والفضاء (الجزء الأول) in term 1; فيزياء 3-2 and علوم الأرض والفضاء (الجزء الثاني) in term 2. There is no biology book in grade 12 except the health-track book «أنظمة جسم الإنسان» (two parts). It is included here under subject_key 'biology' as an extra. Drop those two entries if only the core sciences are wanted. Not included: مبادئ العلوم الصحية, الرعاية الصحية and التنمية المستدامة (track or applied subjects, not core science). There is no separate integrated-science book in secondary school. NAMING: some sites name the books by term-part instead (kottby uses «الكيمياء 1-2», «الأحياء 1-2» and «فيزياء 1-3» for كيمياء 2-1, أحياء 2-1 and فيزياء 3-1). LESSON TITLES are taken from the published tables of contents (فهرس). Feature or enrichment pages are left out. Examples: «السياحة الجيولوجية», «الجيولوجيا والبيئة», «علم الأرض والتقنية», «تطبيقات فضائية», «أثر السدود في النظام البيئي», and the «كيف تعمل الأشياء؟» and «الكيمياء والصحة» pages. ORDER CONFLICTS: in أحياء 1 (1448), kottby shows the chapter as «الفيروسات والبكتيريا» with الفيروسات first. Older sources show «البكتيريا والفيروسات». kottby's 1448 version was used. CONCEPTS: all concept lists are INFERRED (concepts_inferred=true). They were written from the vocabulary (المفردات) and key terms that each lesson of the Saudi McGraw-Hill/Obeikan series teaches, using Saudi book wording. They were not copied from the books' vocabulary boxes, which were not available as text online. Lesson and unit titles are not inferred: they come from the sources. For «أنظمة جسم الإنسان» the chapter and lesson titles were quoted verbatim from kottby. Its part-2 table of contents showed only chapters 8–11, so the book may contain more.
